camera.orientation: camera is above +Z and looks straight down -Z; head/forward +X projects toward token top; tail/rear projects toward token bottom
camera.framing: fixed scale with ground origin at token [50,55]
camera.depthOrder: far-to-near camera depth; higher +Z surfaces render nearer; stable semantic-id tie break

attack.motionSemantics: Attack-informed braced snapping bite: neck recoil, fast angular extension, jaw closure and recovery over four fixed soles

idleA.motionSemantics: Idle_2-informed low four-foot tortoise, small breathing/head motion; shell remains rigid

walkA.motionSemantics: slow lateral-sequence four-beat crawl, .80 duty and at least three grounded feet, low splayed foot recovery

profile.silhouette: tortoise: rigid domed scute shell and overhanging rim, low plastron, splayed sturdy short legs, blunt beaked head on an articulated neck, tiny pointed tail and digging claws
profile.locomotion: slow and faster supported four-beat travel with splayed whole-leg articulation; rigid shell, low recovery and no mammalian gallop
profile.attack: native Attack-informed neck recoil, angular forward bite and jaw snap over four braced feet; exaggerated native jumps/spins are omitted
